svg.desc: sequence diagram: three header boxes (pale green LLM with Reasoning, pale orange Search Toolset, pale blue Video Database) over solid coloured vertical lifelines, grey straight message arrows with small heads carrying bold typed text (dark-green italic Thought, orange italic Tool use, black Observation), a double-headed gathering info arrow between the tool and database lifelines, a quoted question with a video-thumbnail slot and user icon slots at the first and last message, and large ellipses at the bottom of two lifelines for further rounds | source: neurips25-0369_fig1 (neurips25-0369_fig1_p1_mixed.svg) | candidate wave1:sequence-trace-three-lifelines-header-boxes-typed-turns-grey-message-arrows | units: pt at print size | colours as drawn, recolour by role
